card.name: Punctuation in file permissions and URLs
card.fires_on: Punctuation and path pieces inside technical strings: the dashes and letters of ls permission strings, and parts of web addresses such as .php, = and /html.

modes.label: Permission strings
modes.description: Dashes or r/w letters inside a Unix file permission listing.

modes.label: URL and path parts
modes.description: Extensions, equals signs or folder names inside web addresses and server paths.

card.plain: It fires on the symbols and path pieces in computer file listings and web addresses, not on medical content.
